lines.t:
Refers to where <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> are equipped on the
humanoid form of the <c:ffff00>{{tinpet}}<c>.

  <c:ffff00>{{head}}<c> (sometimes written H)
  <c:ffff00>{{right_arm}}<c> (sometimes R)
  <c:ffff00>{{left_arm}}<c> (sometimes L)
  <c:ffff00>{{legs}}<c> (sometimes F)

There are 4 types, each with a different role.
